svg.aria-label: אומדן שינוי בחיכוך המעטפת הממוצע בין מפלסי המדידה (kPa)
svg.title: אומדן שינוי בחיכוך המעטפת הממוצע בין מפלסי המדידה (kPa)
svg.desc: Each reference-relative estimated interval average is drawn as a constant segment; this does not assert uniform local friction within the interval. Depth increases downward. Three boundary-derived intervals per stage use pile-head and cell-face force values from the source workbook, not strain-gauge readings; dashed 3 3 segments and squares distinguish these intervals. Circles identify gauge-to-gauge interval averages; hollow markers flag intervals for review. Other dashed lines show unloading. No interval crosses the O-cell gap, and none extends beyond SG7 to the unmeasured toe. Negative values remain visible.
